asked_by.what: check the outside audit; test the video models that run on Modal against LTX on the battle pictures, $3 on Modal in all; the API-only models wait for the next day

shots.why: the wide battle shot: thousands of soldiers, chariots, dust (soldier stability, crowd motion)
shots.prompt: An epic wide high-angle shot of two Bronze Age armies charging and crashing into each other on a vast dusty plain at sunset, below the walled city of Troy on a distant hill. Thousands of warriors with spears and tall oxhide shields run and clash, two-horse war chariots race through clouds of golden dust, spears rise and fall, dust swirls in the low sun. The camera slowly pushes forward over the battle. Painterly cinematic storybook illustration.

Thousands of warriors with spears and tall shields clash, two-horse war chariots race through clouds of golden dust, the camera slowly pushes forward over the battle. No one speaks. Sound: a great battle roar, clashing bronze, galloping horses, war horns.

shots.why: the close action shot: the two leaders point and raise the spear, the army surges past them (body motion)
shots.prompt: A medium-wide shot from behind two Bronze Age war leaders on a dusty plain at sunset. The younger commander thrusts his arm toward the distant ridge, where a long line of enemy warriors with tall shields stands against the blazing sky. The grey-bearded general with the red crest raises his long spear high. The army behind them surges forward past the two leaders toward the ridge, spears raised, dust rising. Painterly cinematic storybook illustration.
shots.prompt_ltx: A medium-wide shot from behind two Bronze Age war leaders on a dusty plain at sunset. Right away the younger commander points at the distant ridge, where a long line of enemy warriors with tall shields stands against the blazing sky, and shouts in a firm young man's voice: "There! On the ridge!" The grey-bearded general raises his long spear high and roars in a deep, gravelly voice: "Attack!" The army behind them bursts into a great war cry and surges forward past the two leaders toward the ridge. Sound: a war horn, a huge roar of hundreds of men, running feet, clashing shields.

shots.why: the faces shot: both leaders' faces, a few spoken words (face stability, mouth; Wan/Hunyuan only, LTX made it at 1280x704 in the battle run)
shots.prompt: A medium shot of two Bronze Age war leaders walking side by side at the head of their army at sunset, the camera moving slowly backward in front of them. The younger dark-bearded commander turns his head to the grey-bearded general and speaks a few words, his lips moving; the general listens and nods slowly, eyes ahead. Spearmen march behind them in the golden dust. Painterly cinematic storybook illustration.

settings.source: the CLI's own defaults for LTX-2.5 (ltx_pipelines.utils.constants at LTX-2 e98f6d9), as in the battle run

variants.estimate_basis: the battle run: 82 s per 10 s 1280x704 clip, of which ~17 s is denoising and the rest the CLI's own weight load and decode; at 576p/448p ~60-70 s per clip, 4 clips + ~30 s start = ~300 s at $5.09/h

settings.source: the model card at 854c04a4: 12 steps, 121 frames, 24 fps; guidance 1.0 from its guider config (step-distilled, no CFG pass)

variants.estimate_basis: 35 GB from the Volume at the Wan load's ~160 MB/s = ~220 s; Tencent: ~75 s per 121-frame 480p clip on an RTX 4090 with 8-12 steps, an H100 ~2x faster, + VAE decode: ~60 s per clip x 3 + start = ~470 s at $5.09/h

not_run.wan_a14b_lightning: its Volume load alone was 417 s ($0.59) in the bake-off; the per-second price at 720p is measured there ($0.028 per generated second at the margin); a 480p run waits for the money left after these two
